angles.name: Royal drama finale
angles.copy: The beginning of the end for The Crown. Season 6 Part 1 drops on Netflix this Thursday. Ready for the final chapter?

angles.name: Diana's story
angles.copy: The Crown Season 6 Part 1 arrives Thursday, covering Princess Diana's poignant final weeks. It's set to be an emotional watch.

moments.title: Autumn Nations Championship Rugby - Round 5

angles.name: Wales vs All Blacks

angles.name: England vs Japan

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Fixtures

angles.copy: Who's winning this weekend? Newcastle vs Arsenal and Liverpool vs Man Utd are just some of the Premier League highlights. Tell us your scores!

moments.title: London Christmas Lights Switch-Ons Begin
moments.blurb: The festive season officially lights up in London with switch-on events at Marylebone Village (Nov 11), Covent Garden (Nov 12), and Leadenhall Market (Nov 19).

angles.name: Marylebone lights up
angles.copy: Tonight's the night! Marylebone Village switches on its Christmas lights at 6pm. The festive season has officially begun in London!

angles.name: Covent Garden sparkle
angles.copy: Covent Garden's iconic Christmas lights illuminate tomorrow! Get ready for some serious festive sparkle in the capital.

moments.title: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland Opens
moments.blurb: London's annual festive extravaganza, Hyde Park Winter Wonderland, opens its gates for the season, offering ice skating, rides, and Christmas markets.

angles.name: Winter Wonderland is back
angles.copy: Get your skates on! Hyde Park Winter Wonderland opens next week. Who's excited for the festive fun?

angles.name: Christmas in London
angles.copy: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland returns on November 19th! Perfect for family days out or a festive date night. What's your favourite part of Winter Wonderland?

moments.title: Black Friday Deals Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: While Black Friday is officially November 27, many major retailers have already started or are launching early deals and sales this week in the run-up to Christmas.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Jamie Miller holds strong at #1 for an incredible 11th week! Plus, Queens of the Stone Age top the albums chart. What are you listening to this week?

angles.name: Thriller comeback
angles.copy: Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' is back in the Top 5! Halloween might be over, but the King of Pop's classic is still making waves.
